description: Individual patient-level component-resolved diagnostic trials extracted from published studies. Only explicitly recoverable patient-level component results are included.

source.title: Cross-reactive LTP sensitization in food-dependent exercise-induced urticaria/anaphylaxis: a pilot study of a component-resolved and in vitro depletion approach

patients.notes: Table 2 reports positive LTP components. Pru p 3, Cor a 8, Ara h 9, Jug r 3, Pla a 3 and Art v 3 are detected; other listed components including Tri a 14, Mal d 1 and Pru p 1 are not detected.
